_comment: Trimmed from the real Phantom Blade Zero cache (robo-guias.db, old extractor): PowerPyx roadmap (complete as the new extraction reads it) + 3 region pages in discovery order (Mirage Estate before Crimson Forest), one zh Steam guide and one allthings.how page. intro = first line of each page text.

steam.name: The Healer’s Legacy
steam.description: Complete [Flesh Lily], [Apprentice Healer], and [A Healer’s Mercy]

steam.name: Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake
steam.description: Complete [Secrets at the Heart of the Lake]

chapters.title: Step 1: Complete the Game up to the Mirage Estate

achievements.howTo: Obtain the true ending of the game. Complete all tales with a purple icon in the journal once the objective to enter Region 8: Mirage Estate appears, progress to Region 9: Mount Soulrend, then trigger the True Ending.

roadmap.title: Step 1: Complete the Game up to the Mirage Estate
roadmap.summary: Play through the game normally and grab items to become stronger. Watch out for trophies that become missable early, and keep manual saves at the start and end of each region.

roadmap.title: Step 2: Complete True Ending Requirements
roadmap.summary: Once you get the objective to enter Region 8: Mirage Estate through the Green Serpent House in Pangzhen, complete all tales with a purple icon in your journal (see the True Ending Guide).

roadmap.title: Step 3: Obtain the True Ending
roadmap.summary: Progress to Region 9: Mount Soulrend, clean up anything missed or remaining true ending requirements, then trigger the True Ending.

roadmap.title: Step 4: Trophy Clean Up
roadmap.summary: After the final boss, resume in free-roam to return to all areas and grab anything still needed (except missable trophy-related tales), or continue in New Game+.

items.name: Bell (The Beginning)
items.location: Automatically obtained through the story.

items.name: Bell (The Lady's Rift)
items.location: While on the scaffolding, go down the ladder on the right.

items.name: Triple Threat
items.location: Accepted by entering the statue next to The Lady's Rift Bell. Cannot be completed now as you are too underpowered to defeat the boss.

items.name: Hunter's Insight
items.location: From The Lady's Rift Bell, climb the ladder and go across the chain. The enemy directly after the chain drops it.

items.name: Flesh Lily
items.location: Automatically accepted when talking to Yu'er.

items.name: Sanguine Twin
items.location: On the waterfall, just past Yu'er.

items.name: Bell (First Meeting with Yu'er)
items.location: Up the ladder by the waterfall.

items.name: Ancient Armor Fragment
items.location: To the left of the Crimson Manor Bell.

items.name: Prayer Beads
items.location: From the Outpost Bell, defeat the monk near the shop and he drops it. Requires reaching Village of Lu and unlocking the Leave None Alive tale.

items.name: Bell (The Lady's Cave)
items.location: From the Outpost Bell, cross the bridge previously blocked by NPCs into the small town, climb the building on the left and destroy the barricade to enter the cave; the bell is in an opened room.

items.name: Shenji's Ring / Colorful Pinwheel
items.location: From The Lady's Cave Bell, follow the path out of the cave; chest on the right. Interact with a pinwheel to pick it up.

items.name: Memory Flower
items.location: From the Crimson Manor Bell, open the door; on the second floor balcony. Item required: Puppet's Tongue.

items.name: The Way Forward
items.location: Bell: Green Serpent House. Make sure you have completed all possible quests before progressing.

items.name: Yu’er’s Memory Flower – 1. Struggle
items.location: Bell: Estate Rear Gate. Southeast of the bell, in the first area where you fight enemies and are spoken to by the Herald.

items.name: Blackstone Fragment
items.location: Bell: Nuo Mask Altar. Follow the path around instead of dropping into the building, climb the cliffs, grapple to the upper floor; in a chest.

items.name: Song of Parting
items.location: Bell: Cliffside Lodge. Go into the underground area from the bell, to the north end of the tunnel and blow up the wall with Tiger Cannon; in the small cave beside a chest.

items.name: Frostward
items.location: Bell: Burial Grounds. Southwest of the bell, follow the path up and west to the frozen water leading to the Sha-Chi tower; in the first area.

items.name: Bell (Crimson Forest)
items.location: Directly ahead after the story cutscene.

items.name: Memory Flower
items.location: Directly beside the Crimson Forest Bell.

items.name: Bell (Abandoned Main Road)
items.location: On the side of the road after jumping over the barricade.

items.name: Shieldbreaker Talisman
items.location: After jumping over the broken bridge, the chest is on a small scaffolding near some enemies.

items.name: Seal of Dugu
items.location: Requires reaching Village of Lu and unlocking the Leave None Alive tale. From the Thieves' Camp Bell, go onto the giant wooden bridge and defeat the enemy there.

items.name: Thief's Manual
items.location: Requires reaching Village of Lu and unlocking the Leave None Alive tale. Go towards Quick Hand Zhang's hideout and defeat the enemy by the entrance.

source.name: Steam: 影之刃零全成就指南 (Lankec)

items.name: 见习医师
items.location: 先找「玉儿」接取，收齐3种药草回交；建议离开本区前处理

items.name: 隔绝楔子
items.location: 悲泣溪谷首次取石、交付；离开溪谷前交付

items.name: 少主红丝带
items.location: 乘升降梯挑战「“组织”少主：沐小葵」前集齐5条

items.name: 乱莺剑
items.location: 战后木桥尽头；乘电梯离开前拾取，离开后无法返回

items.name: 杀气琥珀碎片
items.location: 战后左侧树旁宝箱；乘电梯离开前拾取

achievements.howTo: 完成其余全部成就；缺少「妖锯」时，检查是否完成「“组织”少主：沐小葵」隐藏阶段

chapters.title: Quest objectives for story and side quest achievements

items.name: Flesh Lily
items.location: Find the Flesh Lily for Yu'er and check on her father; after reaching Pangzhen, return to escort her home, then hand her the Flesh Lily

items.name: Apprentice Healer
items.location: Find the three herbs from Yu'er's medicinal recipe in Weeping Creek Valley and bring them to her

achievements.howTo: Complete three quests: Flesh Lily, Apprentice Healer, and A Healer's Mercy.

difficulty.note: Difficulty does not affect any achievement; all can be earned on Wayfarer, Pathbreaker, Hellwalker, or 66 Days.
